response: A geriatric oncology consultation can indeed modify the cancer treatment plan for elderly patients. According to the available data, such consultations led to a modification of the cancer treatment plan in more than one third of cases. However, further studies are needed to determine whether these modifications ultimately improve the outcome of these older patients. This suggests that geriatric oncology consultations can play a significant role in tailoring cancer treatment plans to the unique needs of elderly patients, but more research is required to fully understand their impact.
